items.exampleEn: The structure of the bridge is very strong.
items.exampleZh: 這座橋的結構非常堅固。

items.exampleEn: I like the style of her dress.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡她那件洋裝的款式。

items.exampleEn: We walked deep into the forest.
Can you give me a specific time?
items.exampleZh: 你可以給我一個明確的時間嗎？

items.exampleEn: Is it necessary to bring my own lunch?
Can I leave my stuff here?
items.exampleZh: 我可以把東西放在這裡嗎？
請把每個細節都告訴我。

items.exampleEn: The city has many modern buildings.
items.exampleZh: 這座城市有很多現代化的建築。

items.sentenceEn: Please take all your stuff with you.
items.sentenceZh: 請把你所有的東西都帶走。

items.audioEn: I like modern style, so my apartment is very simple and white.
items.audioZh: 我喜歡現代風格，所以我的公寓非常簡單、全是白色。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的公寓是什麼風格？

items.sentenceZh: 你可以說得更具體一點嗎？

items.stemEn: I need more ____ about the trip, like the hotel name.
items.stemZh: 我需要更多關於這趟旅行的細節，像是飯店名稱。
水對所有植物都是必要的。

items.passageEn: My uncle builds houses. He says every good house needs a strong structure. Nowadays, many people want a modern style with big windows. Before he starts, he asks his customers for specific ideas and checks every detail. "It is necessary to plan carefully," he says. He also puts the base of each house deep in the ground.
items.passageZh: 我叔叔是蓋房子的。他說每一棟好房子都需要堅固的結構。現在很多人想要有大窗戶的現代風格。開工之前，他會問客人具體的想法，並檢查每個細節。他說：「仔細規劃是必要的。」他也會把每棟房子的地基深深打進地底。

options: 先去五金行買齊所有材料
先帶全家人去海邊度個假

questions.questionZh: 現在很多人想要什麼樣的房子？

items.promptZh: 我的車裡有太多東西了。
referenceEn: There is too much stuff in my car.
I have too much stuff in my car.
rubricZh: 用 stuff 表示「東西」，stuff 不可數（例如 too much stuff）
「有太多」可寫，例如 There is too much、I have too much 等

items.promptZh: 這棟老房子的風格很特別。
referenceEn: The style of this old house is very special.
This old house has a very special style.
rubricZh: 用 style 表示「風格」（例如 the style of this house、has a special style 等）
「很特別」可寫，例如 very special、very unusual 等
